Kabaddi 5 - After the Final Match
description: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match (Nepali: कबड्डी ५) is a 2026 Nepali romantic comedy-drama film written and directed by Ram Babu Gurung. Produced under the banner of Baasuri Films, it serves as the fifth installment in the Kabaddi film franchise and continuing the narrative of Kaji following the events of Kabaddi 4: The Final Match (2022). The film stars Dayahang Rai reprising his iconic role alongside an ensemble cast including Bipin Karki, Bijay Baral, Buddhi Tamang, Miruna Magar, Rishma Gurung and Srijana Gurung. The film was released in theatres across Nepal on 23 October 2026, coincing with the festive Dashain season.

title: Batulo Jun
description: Batulo Jun is a 2026 Nepali romantic drama film directed by Bhuwan K.C. and produced by Jiya K.C. under the banner of Super Kajal Films. Written by Kajal K.C., Sarin Pokharel, and Samipyaraj Timalsena, the film stars Anmol K.C. and Princy Khatiwada in the lead roles, alongside Bhuwan K.C. and Garima Panta. Set in rural Nepal during the 2040s B.S., the film explores a love story challenged by class divisions and traditional social norms. It was released theatrically in Nepal on 12 November 2026.

title: Ek Mutthi Badal
description: Ek Mutthi Badal: My Share of Sky(Nepali: एक मुठ्ठी बादल) is a 2026 Nepali family drama film written and directed by Sahara Sharma. It is produced by Abhimanyu Dixit under Gauthali Entertainment and is an international co-production between Nepal and Germany. The film is scheduled for theatrical release in Nepal on 15 May 2026.

title: Khusma
description: Khusma (Nepali :खुस्मा) is a 2024 Nepali social drama film, written and directed by Ashok Thapa Magar. It is produced by Chandra Bhattachan, Man Bahadur Dhanha Magar, Bir Bahadur Lama, Betany Magar. Rukum Maikot is the most popular song of this movie.

title: Pension Patta
description: Pension Patta (Nepali: पेन्सन पट्टा) is a 2026 Nepalese social-drama film written and directed by Maotse Gurung and produced under the banner of Maotse Gurung Films. Starring Dayahang Rai, Gaumaya Gurung, Pashupati Rai, Buddhi Tamang, Wilson Bikram Rai, and Late Sunil Thapa, the film explores themes of Lahure (foreign military service) culture, family inheritance, unexpressed love, and bureaucratic hardships faced by ex-Gurkha families in rural Nepal. Released theatrically in Nepal on September 11, 2026, the film emerged as a major commercial hit. It received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised its grounded storytelling, emotional sincerity, music, and performances. Audience praised the film's heartfelt portrayal of Lahure culture, sacrifice, and societal realities which made it a compelling family drama.

title: Desh Pradesh
description: Desh Pardesh (1988 - 2001) was an annual arts festival in Toronto that focused on queer and South Asian culture. Desh's mandate was queer-positive, feminist, anti-racist, anti-imperialist, and anti caste/classist. Desh Pardesh is Hindi for "home away from home" or "at home abroad". The festival was an intersection of politics, culture, and activism that aimed to battle stereotypes of lesbians and gays within the South Asian community and to undo North American assumptions about South Asians. The festival consisted of film screenings, workshops, seminars, readings of literary work, performance art, as well as music and dance performances. These programs were typically followed by question and answer sessions with the presenting artists. Desh also hosted discussion groups, exhibitions, workshops, networking sessions, receptions, and dance parties.

description: Jai Bhole (Nepali: जय भोले) is 2018 Nepalese drama romance film, directed by Ashok Sharma and written by Khagendra Lamichhane.
